title: Sequence Flow
description: A directed edge between two nodes of a process flow (Core Model §03 Canvas, Phase B). Endpoints are tasks, gateways, or the process start/end. An optional condition labels a branch out of an exclusive gateway. This is what makes the diagram a real graph rather than a fixed linear sequence.

id.description: Fully-qualified flow id, e.g. CO.3.2.7.f1 — process apqc_code + '.f' + n.

from_node.description: Source node: the process start (__start__), a task (.tN), or a gateway (.gN).

to_node.description: Target node: the process end (__end__), a task (.tN), or a gateway (.gN).

condition.description: Optional guard on a branch (e.g. 'risk_score > 0.7' or 'approved'). Meaningful on flows out of an exclusive gateway.
